records.en_original: One day during summer vacation, I suddenly found myself in this strange world. There, I met a few other girls who are around my age.^00^00This world is connected to another world, which we call "the Faraway." To gather the things we need to survive, and to solve the mysteries of this world, we started exploring the Faraway as part of our daily routine.^00^00...Seriously, what the heck is this place?! [memo]Collect ingredients

コモンで紫乃に遭遇した陽桜莉と瑠夏は、^00そこで「想いのない世界を作る」という彼女の計画へ^00加勢する気持ちを新たにした。^00ただ、コモンの案内役である夕月と来夢の姉妹は^00なぜか焦っている。^00なんにせよ、万が一の事態に備え、^00力を貯えながら紫乃のいるコモンの奥地へ^00向かわなければならない。^00　^00リフレクターの力の源は強い想い。^00ここは姉妹の言うとおり、剥がれ落ちてしまっている^00陽桜莉と瑠夏の想いを一旦回収した方がよさそうだ。
records.en_original: When Hiori and Ruka encountered Shino in the Common, they renewed their resolve to support her plan to create a world without feelings. However, the sisters Yuzuki and Lime, who serve as guides in the Common, seem uncharacteristically anxious. In any case, to prepare for any unforeseen events, they must gather their strength as they make their way deeper into the Common where Shino awaits. The source of a Reflector's power is strong feelings. Just as the sisters suggested, it might be best for Hiori and Ruka to first reclaim the feelings they have lost.

records.jp: コモンの中で美弦たちと戦う時、^00リフレクターとして力が発揮できないと困る。^00だから、自分たちの想いを集める。^00陽桜莉と瑠夏の考えは^00夕月と来夢の願いにも沿っているはずだが、^00なぜか姉妹の顔は暗いまま。^00　^00ただ姉妹いわく、想いに触れた^00２人のフラグメントは確かに回復したようだ。^00ならば想いを回収しない理由はない。^00自分たちの想いだと明らかにわかるような何かは、^00周りにあるだろうか。
records.en_original: When fighting with Mio and the others in the Common, Hiori and Ruka would need to be able to fully use their power as Reflectors. That's why they decided to gather their own feelings. Their way of thinking lines up with Yuzuki and Lime's request, but for some reason, the sisters still looked troubled. However, after Hiroi and Ruka touching their emotions, the sisters told them that their Fragments had indeed recovered. In that case, there was no reason not to collect their feelings. Is there something nearby that would unmistakably prove these are their own feelings?

records.en_original: The shards of the Fragment that had broken off from Hiori and Ruka were distinctly recognizable, thanks to the feelings of someone who had always supported them, protecting those pieces. After being touched by the intense emotions of Miyako who had ran alongside them, Hiori and Ruka's feelings for Shino started to waver. As they make their way deeper into the Common, it wouldn't be surprising if doubts and uncertainties start to spill forth.

records.en_original: When Hiori thought about her only family, her older sister Mio, she couldn't help but let her current anxiety slip out to those around her. Even so, neither of them has time to stand still. While they hesitate in uncertainty, Mio and the others are already moving forward to stop Shino. They need to head deeper into the Common, so they can reach Shino before Mio and the others do.

records.en_original: In a place within the Common that resembled St. Ines Academy's chapel, Hiori and Ruka were suddenly overcome by feelings of unease. According to Yuzuki and Lime, this uneasiness wasn't caused by the instability of their Fragments, but rather by a dark force clinging to them. The events that once took place in the chapel still clearly affect the hearts of the two girls even now. If there is someone else who considers the events in the chapel especially significant, who could it be?

records.jp: 紫乃の選んだ道が正しいかはわからないが、^00自分たちを大切にしてくれている人の気持ちは^00無下にしたくない――礼拝堂での生活を捨て、^00陽桜莉や瑠夏と共に戦ってくれた仁菜の想いは、^00２人の心に変化をもたらした。^00自らの想いを大切な人に捨てられてしまう悲しみを、^00二度と繰り返さないように２人は進む。
records.en_original: Hiori and Ruka may not know whether the path Shino chose is the right one, but they don't want to disregard the feelings of those who care about them. The feelings of Niina, who left her life at the chapel behind in order to fight alongside them, brought about this change in their hearts. The two continue their journey so that the sorrow of being abandoned by someone you care about might never be repeated.

records.en_original: Amiru had lost her Fragment due to misaligned feelings with her childhood friend, Ryoka. Hiori and Ruka recalled that they had fought to protect feelings so that a tragedy like that would never happen again. However, if their only goal was to prevent tragedies that were caused by emotions, both continuing to support Shino's plan or choosing to oppose it were both valid options. A clue to help Hiori and Ruka answer the question of what they are fighting for may lie in the feelings of their senior Reflector.

records.en_original: After witnessing the heartwarming conversation between Mio and Momo, Hiori and Ruka have gradually started to feel a desire to protect the feelings of others. However, there was a time when Mio and Momo were at odds with each other. Hiori and Mio also experienced a period of discord. What was the cause of this, and why did Mio choose to act alongside Shino? Perhaps the key to resolving the doubts Hiori and Ruka now face lies within the feelings Mio has yet to reveal.

records.en_original: Time in this world has already been rewound once. Before it was turned back, Mio had teamed up with Momo as her partner, but fell into despair after failing to save Hiori. For a while, Mio acted alongside Shino, determined to save Hiori this time. However, now even Mio stands against Shino. After recalling Mio's past, both Hiori and Ruka are also beginning to come to terms with their own feelings. All that remains is to remember what the two of them, bound by mutual trust, talked about together. Once they remember that, it should be enough to determine the path they will take.

records.en_original: Recalling the promises they made to each other before setting out for the Common, both Hiori and Ruka's Fragments broke free from Shino's influence. In order to stop Shino's plan, they once again hurry toward the depths of the Common. However, their path is blocked by molten lava. How can they possibly reach the place where Shino waits? Perhaps, to move forward, they will need to confront Shino's own feelings head-on.

records.en_original: The two recalled Shino's tragic past and realized that the lava was a manifestation of her anger. Shino awaits beyond that rage. To stop her plan, it's time to dive into the blazing lava. As long as your partner is by your side, you'll be all right.

records.en_original: The new leader of the Hinomori Squad, who was brought in from Hiroshima as a professional annihilator of Testa, was told by Commander Ayaka on the first day after his transfer that the current organization is on the verge of collapse. Headquarters, which oversees Testa countermeasures, expects the new leader to turn around the squad—a unit described as being "the weakest in history." However, his first meeting with the current members ended on a tense note. Even so, there's no time to be discouraged. Before the team's strength can be assessed, connections need to be built, and before connections can be built, proper introductions need to be made.

records.en_original: The squad is on the verge of falling apart, even over how to treat the new leader. Even the complete rookie who doesn't know left from right is having to deal with these issues. Before combat strength can be worried about, the team's relationships and mentality need to be fixed. At times like this, nothing works better than a solid victory. Having a newcomer on board adds a level of uncertainty, but if the attacking Testa can be taken down, things will take a turn for the better.

records.en_original: With the new leader and Shiho in their ranks, the Hinomori Unit marked their first battle with a victory, and a somewhat positive atmosphere is beginning to take hold. However, some members are still causing discord, so things aren't exactly going smoothly. Amidst all this, Shiho, who has become Alesia's partner, has started seeking advice from other members of the unit. The fact that Alesia's previous partner was killed in the line of duty seems to have taken a toll on Shiho, but just what troubles could she be having? It's the leader's job to proactively check in on the team members' concerns.

After the next mission, she may finally get a chance to give Alesia the gift she prepared.

The squad is beginning to gain momentum, but the pressure from headquarters remains. The two members who continue to not participate in missions are concerning, but with time running short, priority must be placed on what's best for the squad as a whole. If the right people are asked for help, this difficult situation should be able to be overcome.

records.en_original: While gathering information on the Testa, Leader received some information from Kirara regarding her truant partner. Everything seemed to be going smoothly, but in his haste to prepare for the next mission, the leader had forgotten his promise to have a study session with Yukiko and the others. This might be a good opportunity to study up on interpersonal relationships.

records.jp: 先延ばしになっていた菜々花の問題がついに爆発した。^00勝手な行動を取る菜々花にも、^00やむにやまれぬ事情があるようだが、^00彼女を遊ばせておくほどの余裕は日ノ杜部隊にはない。^00異灰もこちらの事情などお構いなしにやってくる。^00菜々花のことは気がかりだが、^00今は自分にできることをやり切るべきだろう。
records.en_original: The relationship problem between the leader and Nanaka which had been put off finally came to a head. Nanaka seems to have her own reasons for acting on her own, but the squad doesn't have enough leeway to let her play hooky, and of course, the Testa aren't going to wait for these issues to be resolved. The situation with Nanaka is concerning, but right now there are other things that have to be done.

records.jp: クイーンと化した樹里をリーダーたちに討伐され、^00菜々花の怒りは頂点に達した。^00しかし詩帆と真正面からぶつかり合い、^00樹里の遺した言葉を知ったことで、^00菜々花はようやく樹里への未練を断ち切るのだった。^00　^00懸案だった３地区目の解放にも成功し、ようやく、^00万事順調と言っても申し分ない状況が部隊に訪れた。^00良い参謀、良い司令は、^00こういうタイミングを見逃さず、^00さらなる訓練を手配するものだ。
records.en_original: Juri, who had been turned into a Queen, was taken down by the leader and the others, enraging Nanaka. However, after clashing with Shiho and learning Juri's last words, Nanaka was finally able to leave her regrets toward Juri behind and begin to move forward. With all three required districts now reclaimed, things are finally looking up for the squad. The commander has taken this opportunity to order some additional training.

records.jp: あやかが手配した戦闘指導員とは、^00ＡＡＳＡに所属する^00陽桜莉というリフレクターのことだった。^00陽桜莉は経験豊富な直感型という、^00ある意味一番厳しい教育係だったが、^00元々知り合いの知り合いだったという^00由紀子が間に入ったことで、^00特別トレーニングは成功裏に終わった。^00　^00こうなることをあやかが見越していたのか、^00部隊のリーダーにもメンバーにもわからないが、^00少なくとも彼女はただ者ではない。^00そんなあやかが再びリーダーを呼び出したからには、^00何か特別な理由がありそうだ。
records.en_original: The combat instructor arranged by Ayaka turned out to be Hiori, a Reflector belonging to the AASA. Hiori, an intuitive type with a wealth of experience, was in a way the most difficult instructor possible, but thanks to Yukiko—an acquaintance of an acquaintance—stepping in as an intermediary, the special training ended in success. Whether Ayaka had foreseen this outcome is unknown to both the squad leader and the members, but it's clear that she's no ordinary person. Ayaka is calling for the leader to come see her again, so there must be some special reason.

records.jp: あやかがリーダーを呼び出したのは、^00きららの脱退希望と^00それに伴う詩の日ノ杜部隊編入を告げるためだった。^00見るからにうさん臭い詩を^00部隊に迎えるのには抵抗があるものの、^00すでに拒否し得ない状況に陥っていた。^00　^00しかし、かつての菜々花ならまだしも、^00どうしてきららが脱退を希望するのだろうか。^00疑問は尽きないが、こういう時こそ^00他のメンバーの意見を参考にすべきだろう。
records.en_original: Ayaka had called the leader to meet her in order to inform him that Kirara had submitted a request to leave the team and to introduce him to Uta, who would be taking Kirara's place. The idea of welcoming Uta into the squad wasn't thrilling, but it was too late to reject her transfer. Still, why would Kirara want to leave the squad? With so many questions at hand, now would be a good time to consult the other team members for advice.

records.jp: どうやら、きららは仲間への劣等感から^00脱退を申し出たようだ。^00そこでリーダーたちは、^00きららに成功体験を積ませるため、^00彼女を中心とした作戦を立案した。^00　^00当のきららもきららで、^00次の任務に向けて１人動き出しているようだ。^00虚勢か、はたまた裏があるのか、^00やる気を出し始めた理由は気がかりだが、^00ここは本人の意欲を尊重すべきだろう。
records.en_original: It seems that Kirara requested to leave the squad due to feelings of inferiority. In light of that, the squad decided to plan a mission centered around her, hoping to give her a taste of success. Kirara seems to be preparing for the next mission on her own. Whether she's just putting on a brave face or there's something else behind her actions, the reason for her newfound motivation is a bit perplexing. Still, with no real clues to go on, it's important to respect her desire to take initiative.

records.jp: 無茶をしたきららが、^00クイーンに乗っ取られかけたが、^00菜々花の活躍でなんとか事なきを得た。^00きららが帰ってきた今、^00日ノ杜部隊はようやく心を一つにできたのだった。^00　^00上昇ムードの中、リーダーのもとに^00「屋上へ来て」とだけ書かれた^00１通の迷惑メッセージが届く。^00本来ならば無視すべきところだが、上機嫌な時ほど^00気まぐれが鎌首をもたげてしまうものだろう。
records.en_original: Kirara acted recklessly and almost was taken over by a Queen, but the crisis was averted thanks to Nanaka. With Kirara back on board, the Hinomori Squad has finally become a complete team. While the mood was uplifted, the leader received a spam message that simply said, "Come to the rooftop." Usually this would be something to just ignore, but with spirits up so high, sometimes curiosity can get the better of you.

records.jp: 空から女の子が降ってくるという、^00誰に話しても信じてもらえないであろう事態に^00遭遇したリーダー。^00ラーコとユーコ……もとい来夢と夕月は、^00部隊のみんなと交流を深めたが、^00２人の最大の目的はリーダーの様子を^00その目で確かめることだったようだ。^00　^00２人が帰って一息付いたところで、^00あやかから呼び出しが掛かる。^00ただし今回呼び出されたのはリーダーではなく、^00詩帆だった。
records.en_original: Girls falling from the sky—as unbelievable as that is, the leader saw it happen right in front of his eyes. The girls were Lako and Yuko—or rather, Lime and Yuzuki—and they had come to get to know the members of the squad, although it seems their main goal was seeing how the leader was doing. Right as there was a moment's rest after the two of them left, Ayaka put out a call to come to her office. However, this time the call wasn't for the leader, but for Shiho.

records.jp: あやかが詩帆を名指しで呼び出したのは、^00知り合いの日菜子が学校を訪れていたからだった。^00　^00千客万来の日ノ杜へ、^00さらに部隊リーダーの古巣である広島から^00新人が派遣されてくる。^00リーダーの加入を経て日ノ杜部隊が軌道に乗った一方、^00逆にリーダーの去った広島では^00人材の新陳代謝が進んだのかもしれない。^00もしリーダー目当てで日ノ杜を訪れたというのなら、^00その新人はある意味来たるべき人だと言えるだろう。^00はたして、あやかの下にいるのはどんな人なのだろうか。
records.en_original: Ayaka had called Shiho to her office because Shiho's acquaintance, Hinako, had come to visit the school. Hinomori continued to get more visitors, including a new recruit from Hiroshima Academy, the leader's former school. While the Hinomori Squad has gotten on track after the leader joined, Hiroshima might be entering a period of personnel turnover after his departure. If the newbie is visiting Hinomori to see the leader, then they're in the right place. Just what kind of person awaits in Ayaka's office?

records.jp: 広島からの見学を受け入れられるほど、^00日ノ杜部隊は急速に成熟していた。^00今こそ、宿願のコズミックファング奪還へ向け、^00部隊が一丸となって地歩を固めていく時だ――^00一応、うさん臭い詩も含めて。
records.en_original: The Hinomori Squad had matured so rapidly that they were to the point of being able to host visitors from Hiroshima. It's finally time for them to steadily pave their way toward their long-held goal of reclaiming the Cosmic Fang—with the dubious Uta included, for now.
records.en: The Hinomori Squad had matured so rapidly that they were to the point of being able to host visitors from Hiroshima. It's finally time for them to steadily pave their way toward their long-held goal of reclaiming the Cosmic Fang—with the dubious Uta included, for now.

records.jp: コズミックファング周辺への遠征計画について、^00詩も含め、部隊全員からの賛成を得られた。^00長期間の遠征へ、準備ができ次第の出発になる。^00本拠地の学校を預けられる上司がいることも、^00１０人にとっては幸いだ。
records.en_original: The entire squad agreed to the plans for the expedition around the Cosmic Fang, including Uta. It'll be a long journey, so preparations need to be completed before heading out. Thankfully, the commander can be trusted to watch over the school while everyone is gone.
records.en: The entire squad agreed to the plans for the expedition around the Cosmic Fang, including Uta. It'll be a long journey, so preparations need to be completed before heading out. Thankfully, the commander can be trusted to watch over the school while everyone is gone.

records.jp: コズミックファング奪還に向けた^00周辺地域への遠征は、^00詩の束縛やその他メンバーの体調不良など、^00様々な変化をもたらした。^00９人万全の状態から、何かがもうすぐ欠け落ちてしまう、^00そんな覚えたくもない予感を運んできたかのようだ。^00　^00この手の予感は、感覚型の人ほど察知しやすい。^00部隊メンバーで一番の感覚型といえば、^00やはりかんなだろう。
records.en_original: The expeditions to the area around the Cosmic Fang brought about a number of changes—such as Uta being restrained and the poor health of the other members. It was as if things went from the team being at their peak to there being an omen that something was about to end. Those who are driven by intuition tend to notice these things more keenly. Among the squad, the one most driven by her intuition is, without a doubt, Kanna.

records.jp: 何かが変わり始めている、^00その予感は消えるどころかむしろ日に日に膨らみ、^00いよいよかんなだけでなく彩未やリーダーも^00察知できるようになってきた。^00　^00詩が捕らわれている中でもこそこそ動き続けていた^00重工系の動向も気がかりだが、^00今はなんといっても、^00この頃塞ぎがちなかんなの様子が^00部隊一番の心配事だった。^00バディの彩未は、特に気にかけているようだ。
records.en_original: The feeling that something is starting to change isn't going away—in fact, it's only getting stronger by the day. Now, not just Kanna, but even Ayami and the leader have started to sense it as well. The Industrials who have been quietly making moves even with Uta being held captive are a concern, but right now, the biggest worry for the squad is Kanna herself, whose mood has been down lately. Her partner, Ayami, seems to be especially concerned about her.

records.jp: かんなは、この世界がもうすぐ滅ぶことを^00知っていたからこそ、^00この後どう生きていくべきか葛藤し続けていたのだった。^00かんなが戻り、^00再び全員万全の状態になった日ノ杜部隊だったが、^00９人が生きていくべき世界の終焉はもう間近だ。^00脱走した詩や、あやかと因縁深い悠良との対峙も^00避けられないだろう。^00　^00９人全員で生き残る、その目標を掲げる、^00日ノ杜部隊最後の戦いが始まる。
records.en_original: Kanna knew that this world was on the brink of destruction, and that knowledge caused her to constantly struggle with how she should live from now on. Although the Hinomori Squad had returned to full strength with Kanna's return, the end of the world is almost here. Confrontation with the escaped Uta and Yura, who shares a deep connection with Ayaka, also seems inevitable. As they hold on to their goal of all nine of them surviving together, the final battle of the Hinomori Squad begins.

records.jp: イローデッドとしての戦闘経験すら皆無の詩帆にとって、^00新しくバディになったアレシアとの交流は、^00日ノ杜部隊での居場所を作る上で^00とても大切なことのようだ。^00アレシアとの距離を縮めるための策を、^00ほかの人に相談し続けている。
records.en_original: For Shiho, who has absolutely no battle experience as an Eroded, building a connection with her new partner Alesia seems very important for finding her place in the Hinomori Squad. She keeps seeking advice from others about ways to get closer to Alesia.
records.en: For Shiho, who has absolutely no battle experience as an Eroded, building a connection with her new partner Alesia seems very important for finding her place in the Hinomori Squad. She keeps seeking advice from others about ways to get closer to Alesia.

records.jp: 詩帆の特徴といえば、^00誰に対しても物腰柔らかに敬語を使うところ。^00日ノ杜部隊一同、ずっとそう思ってきたが、^00なんと詩帆にもタメ口で話すお相手がいるらしい。^00一度それに気がついてしまうと、^00実は詩帆から距離を置かれているのではないかと^00気が気でなくなってしまいそうだ。
records.en_original: One of Shiho's defining traits is her gentle, polite way of speaking to everyone. The entire Hinomori Squad has always thought so, but it turns out there's someone she talks to casually. Once you notice that, you can't help but wonder if Shiho is actually keeping her distance from everyone else.

Once you notice that, you can't help but wonder if Shiho is actually keeping her distance from everyone else.

records.jp: 詩帆は決して気の弱い少女ではない。^00もしそうなら、菜々花の頬を引っ叩くことなど^00できなかっただろう。^00ただ、昔の詩帆を知る人は、^00変わった、と思ってしまうのかもしれない。^00仮に日ノ杜に来て詩帆の何かが変わったとするなら、^00変化の理由はどこにあるのだろう。
records.en_original: Shiho is by no means a timid girl. If she were, she never would have had the courage to slap Nanaka. Still, those who knew Shiho in the past might think she's changed. If something about her has changed since coming to Hinomori, then what could be the reason for that change?
records.en: Shiho is by no means a timid girl. If she were, she never would have had the courage to slap Nanaka. Still, those who knew Shiho in the past might think she's changed. If something about her has changed since coming to Hinomori, then what could be the reason for that change?

records.jp: 人には、他者から認められたいという欲求がある。^00その欲から距離を置ける人は、^00よほどの賢者といえるだろう。^00いつでも落ち着いていて、^00周りに気を配る余裕すら持っている由紀子は、^00そんな賢者のように見えるが、^00実際のところはどうなのだろうか。
records.en_original: Humans have a natural desire to be recognized by others. Only a truly wise person can distance themselves from that need. Yukiko always appears calm and even has enough composure to look out for those around her, much like one such wise person. But is that really the case?
records.en: Humans have a natural desire to be recognized by others. Only a truly wise person can distance themselves from that need. Yukiko always appears calm and even has enough composure to look out for those around her, much like one such wise person. But is that really the case?

records.jp: 大人びている由紀子にも、^00人に言えない秘密や隠された欲望がある。^00考えてみれば当たり前の事実に一番困っているのは、^00当の本人なのかもしれない。^00頭の中でぐるぐると考え込んでしまうタイプの由紀子を^00上手く励ませるのは、きっと、幸せとは何か、^00直感で、あるいは経験から、知っている人だ。
records.en_original: Even Yukiko, who seems so mature, has secrets she can't tell anyone, along with hidden desires. When you think about it, the person most troubled by this obvious fact might be Yukiko herself. The one best able to encourage Yukiko, who tends to get stuck spinning her thoughts around in her head, is surely someone who understands what happiness is—either by instinct or from experience.

The one best able to encourage Yukiko, who tends to get stuck spinning her thoughts around in her head, is surely someone who understands what happiness is—either by instinct or from experience.

records.jp: 由紀子は、大人になるまでの過程を^00すべてすっ飛ばしてしまったような、^00そんな風に大人びていた。^00そんな屈折した人に必要だったのは、^00お星さまに願いごとをするといった、^00純朴な経験だったのだ。^00励まされた由紀子の欲は、もう止まることを知らない。
records.en_original: Yukiko had matured in a way that seemed to have skipped over the entire process of growing up. What someone like that truly needed was a pure, innocent experience, like making a wish upon a star. Now that Yukiko has received encouragement, her desires know no bounds.
records.en: Yukiko had matured in a way that seemed to have skipped over the entire process of growing up. What someone like that truly needed was a pure, innocent experience, like making a wish upon a star. Now that Yukiko has received encouragement, her desires know no bounds.

records.jp: 部隊のほかのメンバーと和解こそしたが、菜々花には、^00まだけじめをつけなければならないことが^00残っているようだ。^00バディの死を悼みたいという気持ちは、^00誰からも否定されるべきものではない。^00センチメンタルな菜々花の心に^00寄り添うことができるとすれば、^00それは同じ過去を背負っている人だろう。
records.en_original: Although she has made peace with the rest of the squad, it seems Nanaka still has something she needs to settle. No one can deny her wish to mourn her fallen partner. If anyone can truly empathize with Nanaka's sentimental feelings, it would be someone who shares the same past.
records.en: Although she has made peace with the rest of the squad, it seems Nanaka still has something she needs to settle. No one can deny her wish to mourn her fallen partner. If anyone can truly empathize with Nanaka's sentimental feelings, it would be someone who shares the same past.

records.jp: バディの死を乗り越えた菜々花は、^00以前までの調子を取り戻したようだ。^00本来の菜々花は、口こそ少し悪いが、快活で、^00何より面倒見がいい。^00たとえば、ぐうたらしているバディを見かけたら、^00なんだかんだ放っておけないのが菜々花だ。
records.en_original: After overcoming her partner's death, Nanaka seems to have regained her old self. Normally, although Nanaka can be a little sharp-tongued, she's cheerful and above all, always looks out for others. For example, if she spots her partner slacking off, Nanaka just can't leave her alone, no matter how she tries to pass it off.
